## Spatial Data Quality Toolkit

A small, focused suite for checking geospatial data before you trust
it. Free, no account, nothing ever leaves your browser.

**Inspect** → **Validate** → **Check Topology** → **CRS**

All four are live — Inspect, Validate geometry, Check Topology, and
find/convert a CRS.

## Raster Toolkit

The next family: reading a GeoTIFF before trusting anything computed
from it. Started with the
[Raster Inspector](raster-inspector.qmd) — dimensions, bands,
resolution, CRS, NoData, and per-band value ranges. A Calculator/Band
Math tool is planned as the next one.
